# The funds feed

US funds and ETFs from SEC Form N-PORT and N-CEN.

The largest US mutual funds and ETFs: their holdings (Form N-PORT), census data (Form N-CEN), fees and risk/return summaries, the funds holding each listed company, and the funds tracking each index.

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | SEC (Form N-PORT, Form N-CEN, risk/return summaries), Nasdaq Trader, GLEIF (https://www.sec.gov/dera/data) |
| Licence | [Public domain (U.S. Government work); GLEIF CC0](https://www.sec.gov/privacy#dissemination): redistributable |
| Attribution | Source: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (Form N-PORT, Form N-CEN) |
| Notes | SEC fair access policy (a descriptive User-Agent with a contact, at most 10 requests a second) |
| Lake | `capitalmarket` (load route `java`) |
| Schedule | daily at 06:15 (local time) |
| Pull | `funds.FundsFeed` (tools/feeds/sources/funds.py); 0.13 s between requests, 3 retries |

## Run it

```bash
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run funds --dry-run      # what it would fetch and load; changes nothing
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run funds                # pull today, write data/datafeeds/funds/<date>/, load into capitalmarket
python3 tools/drishti.py feed status funds             # its last runs
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run funds --snapshot     # refresh the committed demo snapshot instead
```

Daily: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed schedule --cron` (or `--systemd`, `--windows`). The guide: [FEEDS_GUIDE.md](../../docs/guides/FEEDS_GUIDE.md).

## Data contract

### fund

Pack `funds`, kind `fund` (Fund or ETF), table `fund`, key `TICKER`; files `data/datafeeds/funds/<date>/fund.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

A fund or ETF: fact sheet, fees, holdings summary.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TICKER` | id | required | The fund's ticker: its ETF share class where it has one, else its oldest share class; a unit investment trust's listed ticker. Source: SEC company_tickers_mf.json, N-CEN SECURITY_EXCHANGE, the Nasdaq Trader directory, company_tickers_exchange.json. |
| `NAME` | text | required | The series name as filed (upper-case names title-cased). Source: N-PORT FUND_REPORTED_INFO.SERIES_NAME. |
| `TYPE` | text | required | ETF, Mutual fund, Mutual fund with an ETF share class, or ETF (unit investment trust). Source: N-CEN FUND_REPORTED_INFO.IS_ETF, ETF.tsv, the Nasdaq Trader directory. |
| `FUND_KEY` | text | required | The SEC series id, or CIK<cik> for a fund without one (a unit investment trust). Source: N-PORT FUND_REPORTED_INFO.SERIES_ID, REGISTRANT.CIK. |
| `SERIES_ID` | id | optional | The SEC series id (S and nine digits). Source: N-PORT FUND_REPORTED_INFO.SERIES_ID. |
| `CIK` | text | required | The registrant's SEC Central Index Key (ten digits). Source: N-PORT REGISTRANT.CIK. |
| `REGISTRANT` | text | required | The trust or company the series belongs to. Source: N-PORT REGISTRANT.REGISTRANT_NAME. |
| `LEI` | text | required | The fund's (series') LEI; opens its GLEIF record. Source: N-PORT FUND_REPORTED_INFO.SERIES_LEI. |
| `REGISTRANT_LEI` | text | required | The registrant's LEI. Source: N-PORT REGISTRANT.LEI. |
| `TICKERS` | text | required | Every share class ticker, the fund's own first; the type-ahead matches any of them (FUND VTSAX opens VTI). Source: SEC company_tickers_mf.json. |
| `CLASSES` | record list | required | Each share class: id, ticker, name, expense ratio and three-month return. Source: company_tickers_mf.json, N-CEN SHARES_OUTSTANDING, risk/return summary, N-PORT MONTHLY_TOTAL_RETURN. |
| `CLASS_COUNT` | integer | required | How many share classes the fund has. Source: company_tickers_mf.json. |
| `PRIMARY_CLASS` | text | optional | The class id of TICKER; its fees and returns are the page's. Source: company_tickers_mf.json. |
| `IS_ETF` | boolean | required | True when the fund is, or has, an exchange-traded share class. Source: N-CEN IS_ETF, ETF.tsv, SECURITY_EXCHANGE; the Nasdaq Trader directory. |
| `IS_INDEX` | boolean | required | True when the fund says it is an index fund, or its name names a tracked index. Source: N-CEN FUND_REPORTED_INFO.IS_INDEX. |
| `IS_FUND_OF_FUNDS` | boolean | required | True when the fund invests in other funds. Source: N-CEN FUND_REPORTED_INFO.IS_FUND_OF_FUND. |
| `IS_TARGET_DATE` | boolean | required | True for a target-date fund. Source: N-CEN FUND_REPORTED_INFO.IS_TARGET_DATE. |
| `IS_MASTER_FEEDER` | boolean | required | True when the fund is part of a master-feeder structure. Source: N-CEN FUND_REPORTED_INFO.IS_MASTER_FEEDER. |
| `INDEX_ID` | id | optional | The us-equities index the fund tracks (SP500, NDX, DJIA), matched by its name; opens IDX. Source: computed from the name (N-CEN says whether a fund is an index fund, not which index). |
| `EXCHANGE` | text | optional | Where the ETF share class lists. Source: the Nasdaq Trader directory; N-CEN SECURITY_EXCHANGE. |
| `CREATION_UNIT` | amount | optional | Shares in one creation unit of the ETF. Source: N-CEN ETF.NUM_SHARES_PER_CREATION_UNIT. |
| `AP_COUNT` | integer | optional | How many authorised participants the ETF reports. Source: N-CEN AUTHORIZED_PARTICIPANT. |
| `AUTHORISED_PARTICIPANTS` | record list | required | The ten most active authorised participants by purchases and redemptions. Source: N-CEN AUTHORIZED_PARTICIPANT. |
| `ADVISER` | text | optional | The fund's investment adviser. Source: N-CEN ADVISER.ADVISER_NAME. |
| `ADVISER_LEI` | text | optional | The adviser's LEI; opens its GLEIF record. Source: N-CEN ADVISER.ADVISER_LEI. |
| `SUB_ADVISERS` | text | optional | Up to six sub-advisers. Source: N-CEN ADVISER (sub-advisers). |
| `CUSTODIAN` | text | optional | The fund's custodian (not a sub-custodian). Source: N-CEN CUSTODIAN.CUSTODIAN_NAME. |
| `CUSTODIAN_LEI` | text | optional | The custodian's LEI. Source: N-CEN CUSTODIAN.CUSTODIAN_LEI. |
| `ADMINISTRATOR` | text | optional | The fund's administrator (not a sub-administrator). Source: N-CEN ADMIN.ADMIN_NAME. |
| `TRANSFER_AGENT` | text | optional | The fund's transfer agent. Source: N-CEN TRANSFER_AGENT.TRANSFERAGENT_NAME. |
| `AUDITOR` | text | optional | The registrant's independent public accountant. Source: N-CEN PUBLIC_ACCOUNTANT.PUB_ACCOUNTANT_NAME. |
| `AUDITOR_LEI` | text | optional | The accountant's LEI. Source: N-CEN PUBLIC_ACCOUNTANT.PUB_ACCOUNTANT_LEI. |
| `LENDS_SECURITIES` | boolean | required | True when the fund lent securities in the year. Source: N-CEN FUND_REPORTED_INFO.DID_LEND_SECURITIES. |
| `NCEN_PERIOD` | date | optional | The fiscal year end of the N-CEN report used. Source: N-CEN SUBMISSION.REPORT_ENDING_PERIOD. |
| `NCEN_ACCESSION` | text | optional | The N-CEN filing used. Source: N-CEN SUBMISSION.ACCESSION_NUMBER. |
| `GLEIF_RELATIONSHIPS` | record list | required | The fund's relationships in GLEIF: managed by, sub-fund of (its umbrella), feeder to. Source: GLEIF golden copy level 2 (rr.csv). |
| `RANK` | integer | required | The fund's rank by net assets among the funds with a ticker. Source: computed. |
| `REPORT_DATE` | date | required | The date the N-PORT report is as of. Source: N-PORT SUBMISSION.REPORT_DATE. |
| `FILED` | date | required | The date the N-PORT report was filed. Source: N-PORT SUBMISSION.FILING_DATE. |
| `ACCESSION` | text | required | The N-PORT filing used. Source: N-PORT SUBMISSION.ACCESSION_NUMBER. |
| `NPORT_URL` | text | required | The filing's folder on EDGAR. Source: computed from CIK and ACCESSION. |
| `TOTAL_ASSETS` | amount | required | Total assets. Source: N-PORT FUND_REPORTED_INFO.TOTAL_ASSETS. |
| `NET_ASSETS` | amount | required | Net assets: what the 200 are chosen by. Source: N-PORT FUND_REPORTED_INFO.NET_ASSETS. |
| `EXPENSE_RATIO` | rate | optional | The net expense ratio of the fund's share class (gross where no net one is filed). Source: risk/return summary NetExpensesOverAssets, ExpensesOverAssets. |
| `GROSS_EXPENSE_RATIO` | rate | optional | Total annual operating expenses before waivers. Source: risk/return summary ExpensesOverAssets. |
| `MANAGEMENT_FEE` | amount | optional | The management fee. Source: risk/return summary ManagementFeesOverAssets. |
| `TURNOVER` | amount | optional | Portfolio turnover in the last fiscal year. Source: risk/return summary PortfolioTurnoverRate. |
| `PROSPECTUS_FILED` | date | optional | The date of the risk/return summary used. Source: risk/return summary sub.tsv filed. |
| `ANNUAL_RETURNS` | record list | required | Up to ten calendar-year total returns of the share class (the prospectus bar chart). Source: risk/return summary AnnualReturnPercent, AnnlRtrPct. |
| `RETURN_LAST_YEAR` | amount | optional | The latest calendar-year return filed. Source: risk/return summary AnnualReturnPercent, AnnlRtrPct. |
| `RETURN_YEAR` | integer | optional | The year of RETURN_LAST_YEAR. Source: risk/return summary. |
| `RETURN_3M` | amount | required | The share class's three monthly returns of the report compounded. Source: N-PORT MONTHLY_TOTAL_RETURN. |
| `FLOWS` | record list | required | Each of the report's three months: sales, reinvestments, redemptions, net flow and the class's return. Source: N-PORT FUND_REPORTED_INFO SALES_FLOW_MON1-3 .... |
| `SALES` | amount | required | The three months' sales. Source: N-PORT SALES_FLOW_MON1-3. |
| `REDEMPTIONS` | amount | required | The three months' redemptions. Source: N-PORT REDEMPTION_FLOW_MON1-3. |
| `REINVESTMENT` | amount | required | The three months' reinvested distributions. Source: N-PORT REINVESTMENT_FLOW_MON1-3. |
| `NET_FLOW` | amount | required | Sales plus reinvestment less redemptions over the three months. Source: computed. |
| `HOLDING_COUNT` | integer | required | Every holding the fund reported. Source: N-PORT FUND_REPORTED_HOLDING. |
| `HOLDINGS_SHOWN` | integer | required | Holdings kept in HOLDINGS (the 600 largest by value). Source: computed. |
| `HOLDINGS_REST_COUNT` | integer | required | Holdings not kept. Source: computed. |
| `HOLDINGS_REST_PCT` | rate | required | The weight of the holdings not kept. Source: computed. |
| `HOLDINGS_REST_VALUE` | amount | required | The value of the holdings not kept. Source: computed. |
| `TOP10_PCT` | rate | required | The weight of the ten largest holdings. Source: computed. |
| `TOP50_PCT` | rate | required | The weight of the fifty largest holdings. Source: computed. |
| `HHI` | amount | required | The sum of the squared weights (as fractions): 1 is one holding, near 0 is many small ones. Source: computed. |
| `LARGEST` | text | required | The largest holding by value. Source: computed. |
| `LARGEST_PCT` | rate | required | The largest holding's weight. Source: computed. |
| `WITH_LEI` | integer | required | Holdings whose issuer LEI was filed. Source: computed. |
| `EQUITY_PCT` | rate | required | The weight of common equity (asset category EC). Source: computed. |
| `US_COMPANY_PCT` | rate | required | The weight of the holdings that are us-equities companies. Source: computed. |
| `US_COMPANIES` | integer | required | How many us-equities companies the fund holds. Source: computed. |
| `BY_ASSET` | record list | required | The weight by N-PORT asset category. Source: computed. |
| `BY_ISSUER_TYPE` | record list | required | The weight by issuer type. Source: computed. |
| `BY_COUNTRY` | record list | required | The weight by country, the largest ten. Source: computed. |
| `BY_SECTOR` | record list | required | The weight of the us-equities companies held, by SIC division. Source: computed. |
| `DERIVATIVE_COUNT` | integer | required | How many derivatives the fund holds. Source: computed. |
| `DERIVATIVES_NOTIONAL` | amount | required | The notionals added up, by size. Source: computed. |
| `DERIVATIVES` | record list | required | The fifty largest derivative positions by notional, with their counterparties. Source: N-PORT part C.11. |
| `COUNTERPARTIES` | record list | required | The counterparties of the derivatives and repos, by notional: positions, notional, value. Source: N-PORT DERIVATIVE_COUNTERPARTY, REPURCHASE_COUNTERPARTY. |
| `COUNTERPARTY_COUNT` | integer | required | How many counterparties. Source: computed. |
| `HOLDINGS` | record list | required | The 600 largest holdings by value, each with its identifiers and links. Source: N-PORT FUND_REPORTED_HOLDING, IDENTIFIERS. |
| `VIEWS` | record list | required | The page's tabs: Look-through holdings, and the fund against its index when there is one. Source: computed. |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (the SEC data sets read), LICENCE, RETRIEVED_AT (the date the data was downloaded, YYYY-MM-DD) and NOTE. |
| `MOST_HELD_COMPANY` | id | optional | The largest us-equities company the fund holds. Source: computed. |
| `MOST_HELD_NAME` | text | optional | That company's name. Source: us-equities. |
| `ALSO_HELD_BY` | record list | required | The ten other funds holding that company the most, by value. Source: computed from fund-holder. |
| `VS_INDEX` | record | optional | The fund against its tracked index (or the S&P 500 for reference); index weights computed from SEC data. Source: computed. |
| `ACTIVE_SHARE` | rate | optional | Half the sum of the differences between the fund's and the index's weights (VS_INDEX). Source: computed. |

### fund-holder

Pack `funds`, kind `fund-holder` (Funds holding a company), table `fund-holder`, key `TICKER`; files `data/datafeeds/funds/<date>/fund-holder.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

A listed company and the funds holding it.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TICKER` | id | required | The us-equities company's ticker. Source: us-equities us-company.TICKER. |
| `NAME` | text | required | The company's name. Source: us-equities us-company.NAME. |
| `COMPANY` | id | required | The company; opens USEQ. Source: us-equities. |
| `SECTOR` | text | required | Its SIC division. Source: us-equities us-company.SECTOR. |
| `FUNDS` | integer | required | How many of the pack's funds hold it. Source: computed from every fund's holdings. |
| `ETFS` | integer | required | How many of them are ETFs. Source: computed. |
| `TOTAL_VALUE` | amount | required | The value the funds hold together. Source: computed from N-PORT CURRENCY_VALUE. |
| `TOTAL_SHARES` | amount | required | The shares the funds hold together. Source: computed from N-PORT BALANCE. |
| `SHARES_OUTSTANDING` | integer | optional | The company's shares outstanding (10-K cover). Source: us-equities us-company.SHARES_OUTSTANDING (SEC XBRL dei). |
| `PCT_OF_SHARES` | rate | optional | Shares held over shares outstanding; empty where the filed count cannot be compared. Source: computed. |
| `AVG_WEIGHT` | rate | required | Its average weight in the funds holding it. Source: computed. |
| `MAX_WEIGHT` | rate | required | Its largest weight in a fund. Source: computed. |
| `TOP_HOLDER` | text | required | The fund holding the most, by value. Source: computed. |
| `HOLDERS` | record list | required | Every fund holding it, by value (at most 250). Source: computed. |
| `TOP_WEIGHTS` | record list | required | The ten funds where it weighs the most. Source: computed. |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (the SEC data sets read), LICENCE, RETRIEVED_AT (the date the data was downloaded, YYYY-MM-DD) and NOTE. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"TICKER": "AAPL", "NAME": "Apple Inc.", "COMPANY": "AAPL", "SECTOR": "Manufacturing", "FUNDS": 85, "ETFS": 26, "TOTAL_VALUE": 831040821744.0, "TOTAL_SHARES": 2809918580.0, "SHARES_OUTSTANDING": 14776353000, "PCT_OF_SHARES": 19.016, "AVG_WEIGHT": 5.425, "MAX_WEIGHT": 14.5683, "TOP_HOLDER": "VTI"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/funds/contracts/fund-holder.contract.yaml` ([funds](../../docs/contracts/packs/funds.md)).

### index-funds

Pack `funds`, kind `index-funds` (Funds tracking an index), table `index-funds`, key `INDEX`; files `data/datafeeds/funds/<date>/index-funds.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

An index and the funds tracking it.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `INDEX` | id | required | The us-equities index code (SP500, NDX, DJIA). Source: us-equities index-membership.INDEX. |
| `NAME` | text | required | The index's name. Source: us-equities index-membership.NAME. |
| `FUNDS` | integer | required | How many of the pack's funds track it. Source: computed. |
| `ETFS` | integer | required | How many of them are ETFs. Source: computed. |
| `TOTAL_NET_ASSETS` | amount | required | Their net assets added up. Source: computed from N-PORT NET_ASSETS. |
| `LARGEST` | text | required | The largest tracking fund. Source: computed. |
| `ROWS` | record list | required | The tracking funds by net assets. Source: computed. |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (the SEC data sets read), LICENCE, RETRIEVED_AT (the date the data was downloaded, YYYY-MM-DD) and NOTE. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"INDEX": "NDX", "NAME": "Nasdaq-100", "FUNDS": 2, "ETFS": 2, "TOTAL_NET_ASSETS": 587254661099.0, "LARGEST": "QQQ"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/funds/contracts/index-funds.contract.yaml` ([funds](../../docs/contracts/packs/funds.md)).
